verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing (brex-docs-10) mentions 'cash back with a Brex business account', so the product claims some form of cashback. Nothing in the pack shows that it is earned automatically on card spend or that no manual redemption step is needed. Missing for 10: documentation that cashback accrues automatically on card spend, evidence of no manual redemption, cashback rates/terms, independent or hands-on corroboration.
